title: Add Ramayan and Mahabharat full kathas to the Katha section

requirements.summary: Add comprehensive Ramayan and Mahabharat full katha entries to the frontend static fallback data with complete Hindi narratives covering all major episodes
acceptanceCriteria: kathaData.ts contains a Ramayan katha entry with full Hindi text and all major kandas
kathaData.ts contains a Mahabharat katha entry with full Hindi text and all major parvas
Both entries appear in the Kathayen listing page under the 'Puranik' category tab
Both entries are clickable and open their full text in the KathaDetail page
The KathaDetail page renders the full Hindi text with narration support via the existing TTS hook

file_operations.description: Add two new Katha entries to the staticKathaList array: (1) Ramayan - Sampurna Katha with category 'puranik', deity 'Ram', full Hindi narrative text covering all seven major kandas (Bal Kand: Ram's birth, childhood, breaking of Shiv Dhanush and marriage to Sita; Ayodhya Kand: Dasharath's promise, Kaikeyi's demand, Ram's 14-year exile decision; Aranya Kand: forest life, golden deer, Sita's abduction by Ravan; Kishkindha Kand: alliance with Sugriva, meeting Hanuman, search for Sita; Sundar Kand: Hanuman's leap to Lanka, meeting Sita, burning Lanka; Lanka Kand/Yuddha Kand: building Ram Setu, 18-day war, Ravan's defeat, Sita's agni pariksha; Uttar Kand: return to Ayodhya, Ram's coronation, establishment of Ram Rajya), and English summary, with status 'approved', tags ['Puranik', 'Ram', 'Epic'], id as next available bigint; (2) Mahabharat - Sampurna Katha with category 'puranik', deity 'Krishna', full Hindi narrative text covering all major parvas (Adi Parva: Kuru dynasty origins, Pandava and Kaurava birth, Draupadi swayamvar; Sabha Parva: Yudhishthira's Rajasuya yagna, dice game with Shakuni, Draupadi's vastraharan, 13-year exile; Vana Parva: forest exile stories, Krishna's visits; Virata Parva: incognito year in Virat's kingdom; Udyoga Parva: peace negotiations fail, war preparations, Krishna as envoy; Bhishma Parva: war begins, Bhagavad Gita on battlefield, Bhishma's fall on bed of arrows; Drona/Karna/Shalya Parvas: key battles of the 18-day Kurukshetra war, deaths of major warriors; Stri Parva: lamentation of widows; Shanti/Anushasana Parvas: Bhishma's teachings to Yudhishthira; Ashvamedha Parva: Yudhishthira's horse sacrifice; Swargarohana Parva: Pandavas' final journey to heaven), and English summary, with status 'approved', tags ['Puranik', 'Krishna', 'Epic'], id as next available bigint. Ensure Ramayan is inserted before Mahabharat in the array order. Match the existing Katha interface structure exactly (id as bigint, status as KathaApprovalStatus, category as KathaCategory, createdAt as bigint timestamp, hindiText and englishText as strings, tags as string array).
